title: coord dedup still claims a whole-topic key with a * and keys over 120 characters for a long topic, and drops non-ASCII letters from term ids
goal: every key coord.py dedup claims fullmatches FIELD_VALUE, the whole-topic key and a topic of 104 or more characters included, a term id keeps a readable form of a non-ASCII term, and the kb-research skill's text on uncovered names what it holds

run: import argparse,os,sys,tempfile,time;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import coord;coord.fingerprint=lambda q,t=None:('logs/otel-python-sdk',[]);s=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'c.sqlite');b=coord.dedup(argparse.Namespace(store=s,holder='h',topic=None,token=None,ttl=60,question='q'),time.time);bad=[k for k in b['claimed'] if not coord.FIELD_VALUE.fullmatch(k)];print('claimed past FIELD_VALUE:',bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
